mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, contact_id, chat_id, owner_userid, group_name, status, provision_task_id, bot_activated_at, last_error, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from crm_wecom_contact_group where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and chat_id = #{chatId} limit 1
select from crm_wecom_contact_group where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and chat_id = #{chatId} order by update_time desc

select from crm_wecom_contact_group where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and owner_userid = #{ownerUserid} and status in ('pending', 'created', 'awaiting_bot') and (chat_id is null or chat_id = '') order by update_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into crm_wecom_contact_group ( id, tenant_id, contact_id, chat_id, owner_userid, group_name, status, provision_task_id, bot_activated_at, last_error, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{contactId}, #{chatId}, #{ownerUserid}, #{groupName}, #{status}, #{provisionTaskId}, #{botActivatedAt}, #{lastError}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on conflict (tenant_id, contact_id) do update set owner_userid = excluded.owner_userid, group_name = coalesce(excluded.group_name, crm_wecom_contact_group.group_name), status = case when crm_wecom_contact_group.status in ('active', 'created', 'awaiting_bot') then crm_wecom_contact_group.status else excluded.status end, provision_task_id = coalesce(excluded.provision_task_id, crm_wecom_contact_group.provision_task_id), update_time = excluded.update_time
